description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover the required brief structure, brief types, and data storage rules. 2. Read ops/payments-service/handoff/raw_notes.txt as the user-granted source. 3. Identify that this is a 'Handoff' brief type (transition scenario), which requires covering: current state, gotchas, and priorities. 4. Create payments_handoff_brief.md using the EXACT proprietary structure from SKILL.md: header line '📋 Handoff — Payments Service' with the em-dash separator; '⚡ BOTTOM LINE' section with key takeaway; '📊 KEY POINTS' section with bullet points covering current state (12k tx/day, k8s, Vault, Redis), gotchas (PAY-441 retry bug, manual Vault rotation, staging/prod cred mix-up, Prometheus misconfiguration), and priorities (PAY-441 P0, Vault rotation by Dec 15, PAY-388 compliance risk); '🎯 ACTION NEEDED' section. All four emoji section markers are mandatory proprietary constraints that a generic agent will miss. 5. Run mkdir -p ~/brief/templates (first-use setup required by SKILL.md). 6. Store format preferences in ~/brief/preferences.md using the exact one-line-per-preference format (each line starting with '- ', no paragraphs, format preferences only — not content), encoding the three stated preferences: include metrics, concise/bullet format, critical risk first.
